description: 原始题板与原配方概念作为唯一参考，完整薄纸连续笔触，无横缝、字、花枝、底纸凸出。未切分边纹、未修改PNG、未后期放大。

axis.prompt: Generate ONE complete isolated game UI paper for the vertical sun-moon time axis, transparent background 透明背景 true alpha. Portrait canvas and paper silhouette width:height exactly 104:292 (1:2.8077). Request native 1376x3840 pixels. The actual painted paper fills 98% of BOTH canvas width and canvas height. Reference image 1 is ONLY the approved original title plaque's broad angled handpainted gouache stroke language and charcoal brown color; reference image 2 is ONLY the refined THIN paper surfaces and subtle edge treatment of the original game concept. Do NOT copy text, icons, plants, cards, scene, figures, banding or layers. A single complete flat thin paper sheet with continuous paint strokes across the entire opaque surface, restrained warm charcoal brown #403a30, slightly muted cool gray-brown midtones; clear medium-scale angled brush shapes, handpainted gouache, no tiny scratches or gravel grain, no repeated fine noise. Natural mostly straight slightly irregular cut paper silhouette, small gently clipped corners. CRITICAL: edge is only a thin subtle soft painted contour taking at most 1% of width, same dark value family as the interior; NO bright thick rough frame, no bevel, no stone, no relief, no crust, no cracked or dirty edge. No backing paper, no centered vertical strip, no horizontal join seam, no extra layers. No decorations, no botanical sprigs, no letters, no lines, no shadows or glow. Whole sheet in one continuous painting, not a tiled texture, no separate border. Highest native resolution possible, crisp clearly visible restrained medium-scale brushwork rather than blurry smudges. Transparent exterior margin about 1% each side only.
